ptr.note: Call-scoped borrow; no caller pointer retained. Context storage and children remain C-owned; byte buffers have the scalar length/count or backend digest size.

Lowercase hex digest via snprintf(dst + 2i, size - 2i, "%02x") for i < min(digest size, size / 2): writes at most min(2 * digest size + 1, size) bytes, NUL-terminated, never more. size is an upper bound and may be any int up to the buffer length (INT_MAX for longer buffers). Sizes 0 and 1 write nothing and leave dst unterminated despite the header; the context is finalized regardless. No retention.
